System Architecture

The Deep Research Engine is built on a recursive, multi-agent orchestration pattern using LangGraph. It prioritizes state persistence, semantic memory, and high-fidelity critique loops.

Overview

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
graph TD
    A[Input Query/Files] --> B{Auto-Ingest}
    B -->|Text| C[LangGraph Store]
    B -->|Non-Text| D[Converters]
    D --> C
    C --> E[Boss Agent]
    E --> F[Worker Registry]
    F --> G[Flash Explorers]
    G --> H[Specialists]
    H -->|Findings| C
    C --> I[Critic Agent]
    I -->|Revise| E
    I -->|Pass| J[Synthesis Node]

Core Components

1. The Orchestration Layer (LangGraph)

Everything in the engine is a node in a state graph.

  • arrow_forwardCheckpointer: State persistence via PostgreSQL, allowing sessions to be paused and resumed
  • arrow_forwardStore: A unified, auto-vectorized memory system where every write_file operation is automatically embedded and indexed for semantic search

2. Deep Agent Hierarchy

We employ a tiered model approach to balance intelligence and cost:

  • arrow_forwardSmart Tier (Claude 3.5 Sonnet): Used for the Boss Agent (planning) and Critic Agent (evaluation)
  • arrow_forwardFast Tier (Claude 3.5 Haiku): Used for Flash Explorers and specialized task runners

3. Integrated Storage Stack

The backend relies on a harmonized suite of databases:

  • arrow_forwardPostgres + pgvector: The primary brain for state and semantic memory
  • arrow_forwardNeo4j: Optional knowledge graph builder for extracting complex relationship entities
  • arrow_forwardMinIO: Object storage for large artifacts, reports, and raw media
architecture

5-Node Pipeline

The engine uses a simplified 5-node architecture:

TERMINAL_S01 // SRC_LOG
┌─────────────┐     ┌─────────────┐     ┌─────────────┐     ┌─────────────┐     ┌─────────────┐
│  Ingestion  │ ──→ │   Drafter   │ ←─→ │   Critic    │ ──→ │    Neo4j    │ ──→ │  Synthesis  │
│    Node     │     │    Node     │     │    Node     │     │   Builder   │     │    Node     │
└─────────────┘     └─────────────┘     └─────────────┘     └─────────────┘     └─────────────┘
       ↓                   ↓                   ↓                   ↓                   ↓
  Extract text        Plan & execute      Quality gate      Build knowledge     Generate final
  from sources        research tasks      & revision        graph               report

Ingestion Node

  • arrow_forwardExtracts text from various sources (PDFs, audio, video, web)
  • arrow_forwardConverts multimodal content to clean text
  • arrow_forwardUses VibeVoice ASR for audio transcription with diarization
  • arrow_forwardIntegrates with shared multimodal tools

Drafter Node

  • arrow_forwardMain research logic
  • arrow_forwardOrchestrates Flash subagents for autonomous exploration
  • arrow_forwardFans out to specialist workers for specific tasks
  • arrow_forwardAccumulates findings in state

Critic Node

  • arrow_forwardQuality assurance gate
  • arrow_forwardEvaluates findings against criteria
  • arrow_forwardRoutes back to Drafter for revision if needed
  • arrow_forwardEnsures completeness and accuracy

Neo4j Builder Node

  • arrow_forwardOptional knowledge graph construction
  • arrow_forwardExtracts entities and relationships
  • arrow_forwardBuilds semantic connections
  • arrow_forwardEnables graph-based queries

Synthesis Node

  • arrow_forwardGenerates final output
  • arrow_forwardFormats as research report, markdown, or JSON
  • arrow_forwardAdds citations and metadata
  • arrow_forwardProduces deliverable artifacts
architecture

Specialized Workers

Workers are registered in a central registry and can be dynamically spawned by the Drafter.

| Worker | Capabilities | | :--- | :--- | | Web Researcher | Autonomous search, link crawling, and content extraction | | Document Processor | Deep chunking and semantic analysis of long-form reports | | Multimodal Agent | ASR (Whisper), VLM (Vision), and frame-by-frame video analysis | | Scraper | Web scraping with robots.txt compliance | | Synthesis | Report generation with citation formatting |

architecture

Architectural Philosophy

Editorial_Note

"Do not trust, verify."

The Critic Node is the gatekeeper. No research finding is accepted until it has been cross-referenced against the internal store and validated by a secondary high-intelligence model.

architecture

Design Decisions

Generic State Design

  • arrow_forward18 fields max - Avoids the 50+ field bloat of previous implementations
  • arrow_forwardContext dict - Workflow-specific data stored in context field
  • arrow_forwardType safety - TypedDict for IDE support and mypy validation

Pluggable Storage

  • arrow_forwardOptional backends - Enable only what you need
  • arrow_forwardUniform interface - All backends implement StorageBackend ABC
  • arrow_forwardRegistry pattern - Easy to add new backends

Worker ABC

  • arrow_forwardUniform contract - All workers implement execute(state, config) -> WorkerResult
  • arrow_forwardBuilt-in helpers - Timing, error handling, retry logic
  • arrow_forwardRegistry pattern - Dynamic worker discovery

Config-Driven

  • arrow_forwardNew workflow = new YAML - No code changes needed
  • arrow_forwardEnvironment variables - Secure configuration with ${VAR} syntax
  • arrow_forwardValidation - Schema validation on load
